problem_name: p04012 AtCoder Beginner Contest 044 - Beautiful Strings
p02899 AtCoder Beginner Contest 142 - Go to School
solution_code:
N = int(input())
A = [int(i) for i in input().split()]
B=[0]*N
for i in range(N):
  B[A[i]-1]=i+1
print(*B)

n=int(input())
k=1
while(n>k):
   n-=k
   k+=1
print(n)
